summary: Keep one active Odfjell Terminals US platform covering Houston and Charleston, correct the legal top company to Odfjell Terminals US Holdings LLC, and preserve the current Northleaf 49% / Odfjell 51% ownership through NCP US Terminals LP and Odfjell Terminals Americas LLC. The 2025 refinancing and August 2026 Delaware ruling did not change equity ownership.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The specific Northleaf-managed fund names are not publicly disclosed.
The dates of Odfjell's internal transfers between direct member vehicles and the exact mapping of the annual-report Topco LLC label are not publicly disclosed.
recommendedActions: Retain one canonical U.S. terminal platform and keep Houston and Charleston together beneath Odfjell Terminals US Holdings LLC.
Retain Northleaf as an active 49% owner from the June 7, 2019 legal close through NCP US Terminals LP.
Add Odfjell SE as the active 51% co-owner through Odfjell Terminals Americas LLC and preserve its prior direct-member vehicles as history.
Retire Lindsay Goldberg's 49% period at the June 7, 2019 sale to Northleaf-managed funds.
Close the shareholder-dispute milestone as decided without an ownership change and do not create separate PortCos for terminal subsidiaries, tanks, docks, pipelines or financing SPVs.
